objective: Implement the deterministic P17 Benchmark / Quant Gate and certify G9_QUANT_VALIDATED only when complete P17-A..P17-H lineage and all required governed benchmark categories pass.
scope: Require exact canonical evidence coverage for P17-A through P17-H
Require Strategy Registry and Model Registry identities
Require explicit governed benchmark criteria with no production numeric defaults
Require benchmark categories OOS_EDGE, RISK, ROBUSTNESS, CAPACITY and EXECUTION_REALISM
Support explicit GE and LE comparators over scaled integer metrics
Require SHA-256 evidence identity per benchmark criterion
Reject duplicate categories, duplicate workstream evidence, invalid lineage identities or failing criteria
Canonicalize inputs for deterministic G9 identity
Emit G9_QUANT_VALIDATED / PASS only for complete valid evidence
out_of_scope: Changing Strategy or Model Registry records
dependencies: Owner P17 phase authorization already consumed
tests: Complete P17-A..P17-H evidence + passing benchmark categories certifies G9_QUANT_VALIDATED
Failing GE/LE benchmark criterion fails closed
Input ordering does not change gate identity
No execution or production-promotion authority is emitted
P17-I evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P17-I gate/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P17-H remains canonical complete and G9 remains not reached.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: G9_QUANT_VALIDATED PASS is deterministic and fail-closed
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
